import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        String s = sc.next();
        sc.close();
        int len = s.length();
        StringBuilder ret = new StringBuilder();
        boolean at = false;

        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            if (i + 2 <= len && s.substring(i, i + 2).equals("at") && !at && i != 0 && i != len - 2) {
                ret.append('@');
                at = true;
                i++; // skip the 't' as the loop will increment i again
            } else if (i + 3 <= len && s.substring(i, i + 3).equals("dot") && i != 0 && i != len - 3) {
                ret.append('.');
                i += 2; // skip the 'ot' as the loop will increment i again
            } else {
                ret.append(s.charAt(i));
            }
        }

        System.out.print(ret.toString());
    }
}
